Figure 2. Overview of PAMNet, a novel framework inspired by signal modulation. The architecture begins by generating adaptive phase EP and amplitude EA carrier signals from a cycle index t. These carriers then modulate the encoded time series EX within two parallel paths, which explicitly capture cyclical dynamics through a phase-amplitude decoupling modulator. The resulting representations are fused and passed through a final MLP to produce the forecasting values Ŷ .
